note: Corps of Engineers campground on the White River arm of Table Rock Lake south of Eagle Rock, on grassy loops either side of Highway 86, with a swimming beach, marina, boat ramp and playground. Sites 1-11 line a wooded bluff above the shore; sites 12-16 look over the beach and ramp lot. --Claude
summary: Confirmed USACE campground: 50 catalog sites (25 electric 30/50 A, 25 non-electric), lengths mostly 30-70 ft. Fees 16-23 -> 16-25 (site 18, electric + water, is $25). Season added May 1 - Sep 15 from the rate season and calendar. Booking/facilities/discounts written manual. WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview proposed: no site has an open apron to the water. Pin is on the west loop (fine). Add rec.gov phone 417-271-3215.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakefront -> lakeview): plotted every catalog site on imagery. Sites 01-11 sit on the west loop ~85-100 m above the shoreline through a continuous wooded slope - no open apron. Sites 12-16 are at the south end beside the boat-ramp parking lot: site 14 is ~30 m from the water but across the paved ramp lot, sites 12-13 are ~55-60 m back with the road and the swimming beach between; the lake is in open view from them. The sites east of Highway 86 (30-51) are 250 m+ from the water. No site meets the riverfront/lakefront rule (open apron within ~50 m, no road/ramp lot/beach between), so lakeview (sites 12-16, and leaf-off views from the bluff sites). recreation.gov's catalog carries no Proximity to Water attribute. The stored value rested only on the commit that added 41 USACE lakes, with no per-entry evidence.

FEES changed: stored derived 16-23 -> 16-25. The 2026 rate table has three prices; site 18 (campsite 21744, 'Water Hookup Y', 30 A) is on the $25 'STANDARD ELECTRICu21...' template. Every other electric site $23, non-electric $16.

HOOKUPS: electric 50 kept (now manual). 30 A at 22 sites, 50 A at sites 23, 24, 41. Water only at site 18 (1 site, under the 3-yes rule), no sewer anywhere - water/sewer left absent (unknown), not false.

SEASON added (none stored): 05-01..09-15. Earlier years' peak seasons ended 09-14; 2026 ran to 09-15. The calendar offers no nights Oct-Apr (empty availability for every site), so it is closed off-season rather than FCFS.

FIT: maxlen across the 48 RV-usable sites: 45 at 23 ft or more (most 30-70 ft); sites 04 (20 ft), 09 and 16 (22 ft) and 03 (0, unlisted) are short. Two sites are tent-only. A 23-ft rig fits the electric loops (every electric site 30 ft+).

BOOKING: rules also say minWeekendStay 0 and reservationCutOff 0; the facility record says 51 reservable campsites (catalog 50). militaryDiscount rule value 1 'Military Discount' is present in the rules; not written to discounts.military because the rule's meaning (offered vs a flag) is not stated - lead only.

PIN: stored 36.5272,-93.7300 is the RIDB facility point, but it lands on the west loop beside site 07, inside the campground. Fine; no move needed. If a central point is wanted, 36.5272,-93.7285 sits in the middle of the west loops.
PHONE (add): recreation.gov facility_phone '417-271-3215'. Entry has no phone.

Note rewritten: 'paved lakeside electric RV pads' (not supported - most pads are paved, electric sites are not by the water) and 'reservable online' (now booking) removed; where the sites sit relative to the water put in.
